title: Scatter graphs: does more practice mean better marks?

marks.label: 9 hours: 85%
marks.ask: What is a line of best fit?

explain.say: Does practising more help you score better? Ten friends in Jakarta write down their hours of practice and their test marks. Each friend becomes a dot on a scatter graph. Look at the first point.

draw.text: Scatter graphs: does more practice mean better marks?

marks.label: 9 hours: 85%
marks.ask: What is a line of best fit?

explain.say: As you move right, more hours, the dots tend to go up, higher marks. When both go up together, that is positive correlation. Correlation means a link. Can you see the pattern?

marks.label: 9 hours: 85%
marks.ask: What is a line of best fit?

explain.say: We can draw a line of best fit through the middle of the dots. It helps you predict. About 9 hours of practice might give about 85 percent.

marks.label: 9 hours: 85%
marks.ask: What is a line of best fit?

explain.say: Correlation can go the other way. Older cars usually cost less: as one goes up, the other goes down. That is negative correlation. Can you think of two things with no link at all?

Like shoe size and maths marks: no link! Great job. Wow: ice cream sales and sunburn rise together, but ice cream does not cause sunburn. Hot weather causes both. Challenge: what correlation might hours of TV and hours of sleep have?

faq.a: A graph of pairs of data, where each pair is one dot. It shows whether two things are linked.
When one value goes up, the other tends to go up too, like hours of practice and test marks. The dots slope upward.
asks: What does positive correlation look like?

faq.a: When one value goes up, the other tends to go down, like the age of a car and its price. The dots slope downward.
asks: What does negative correlation look like?

faq.q: What is a line of best fit?
faq.a: A straight line drawn through the middle of the dots, with about as many above as below. It helps you predict values.
asks: How do you draw a line of best fit?

faq.q: Does correlation mean one thing causes the other?
faq.a: No. Two things can rise together because a third thing causes both, like hot weather causing ice cream sales and sunburn.

facts: A line of best fit should follow the trend of the points, not join them dot to dot.

quiz.say: As temperature goes up, sales of hot drinks go down. What correlation is this?
quiz.why: One goes up while the other goes down, so it is negative correlation.

wrong.1: Positive means both go up together.
wrong.2: There is a clear pattern, so there is some correlation.

quiz.say: What is a line of best fit used for?
quiz.show: Line of best fit is for…
quiz.why: It shows the trend so you can estimate new values.

wrong.1: It goes through the middle of the dots, not dot to dot.
wrong.2: The mode is an average, not something a scatter line finds.
